about: A plain enum has no titles (chapter 2 § 2.2.1), in a template's read too. The plan's prompt names the input note_kind, a plain enum. Invalid: it reads input.note_kind.title. Valid: input.note_kind.value.
sentences: 'input.note_kind.title' reads the title of a plain enum, which has none; use a labelled oneOf, or read .value.
